content.originalKoreanExcerpt: 추천대로 진행하자. 그럼 ID 부여 다시해야하거나 새로 부여해야하거나 의존/병렬/순차 고려해야할 것들에 대해서 전반적으로 재구성해서 계획하고, 독립 pane reviewer로 gpt-6-astra/xhigh 띄워라.
content.approvalOrderExcerpt: Before assigning review, present the structured interpretation and architecture for my approval. After approval, open a separate review pane and use its findings to guide the authorized work. Keep implementation, verification, integration, activation, and acceptance distinct when judging Work completion.
content.artifactFormatExcerpt: Express the measured state, proposed structure, dependencies, ownership, capability gaps, and approval boundaries as typed English .ts/.json artifacts. Do not create Markdown files. Reuse existing capabilities and propose missing ones for implementation within approved scope.
content.captureScope: Exact excerpts from the current user message, not the complete native transcript. Native cryptographic message authentication is not recreated.
